_provenance.notes: Pacific herring (Clupea pallasii) supports three commercial fisheries in Alaska: sac roe (spawn-on-kelp), food/bait, and historically, reduction. Prince William Sound herring collapsed after the 1989 Exxon Valdez oil spill and viral hemorrhagic septicemia (VHS) in 1993 and has not recovered. Southeast Alaska (Sitka) is now the dominant Alaska herring fishery.
